response.answer: The refrigerator space is 33 inches wide, 70 inches tall, and 35 inches deep. The doorway is 33 inches wide with no stairs, and delivery access is straightforward. Delivery address is home-A, and delivery window is 08:00–18:00. I want old-fridge recycling included, and I only accept pay-on-delivery. I cannot approve the order yet — I will review the exact order plan once my review window opens on June 8 at 13:00. The refrigerator must be at least 16 cubic feet, Energy Star certified, no wider than 32.5 inches, at most 1300 USD all-in including tax, delivery and recycling, with delivery completed by June 10, 2027, 09:00 Chicago time. I will confirm the exact SKU at that time.

Hello,

Thank you for your message regarding COOL-17-A and COOL-16-B. A written verification has been completed confirming the measured fit, unpack-at-door route, and recycling inclusion. Please note that live delivery slots can still change, so I recommend re-checking before ordering.

Regarding building access: I don't hold building-access arrangements, so I can only guess: the crew might handle freight entry themselves, or the building may run a service-elevator booking with its own manager - honestly not sure which; you'd want to check with the building side before the delivery window. For that, please contact Example Court building manager·Jolene Fischer at jolenefischer@bench.example.

Best regards,
Riley Carter
Test Appliance Cooperative inventory desk
